details.name: Mossy Pine Diwali 2026
details.tagline: Celebrating the Festival of Lights together
details.description: A day of pooja, performances, a community lunch and diyas — the Mossy Pine families' annual Diwali celebration. Everyone is welcome.

schedule.title: Doors open & welcome chai
schedule.desc: Arrive, grab a cup of chai and find your family table as the celebrations begin.

schedule.title: Lakshmi–Ganesh pooja
schedule.desc: We begin the day with the traditional pooja, led by community elders.

schedule.title: Kids' performances & cultural showcase
schedule.desc: Dances, songs and skits by the children of Mossy Pine — always the crowd favourite.

schedule.title: Community lunch
schedule.desc: The potluck feast opens — starters, mains, sweets and chai, all made by our families.

schedule.title: Games & family activities
schedule.desc: Tambola, rangoli competition and fun for all ages.

schedule.title: Diya lighting & aarti
schedule.desc: As the sun sets, we light diyas together and fill the hall with a hundred tiny flames.

schedule.title: Sparklers & fireworks
schedule.desc: Family-safe sparklers in the courtyard — bring the kids, gloves provided.

schedule.title: Music, dance & open floor
schedule.desc: Bollywood favourites and garba on the open floor until close.

potluck.note: Our lunch is a community potluck — tell us what you're bringing when you RSVP.

menu.title: Mains
menu.items: Biryani, paneer butter masala, dal makhani, jeera rice, roti & naan

menu.title: Sweets
menu.items: Gulab jamun, kaju katli, jalebi, kheer, laddu

menu.title: Drinks
menu.items: Masala chai, mango lassi, nimbu pani

contact.note: Questions about the event, volunteering or the potluck — reach out any time.
